summary:
plan.md fixes the form of all five plots at the brief's exact coordinates: the tower has pale blue-grey laced legs that step in at y46, stacked X-bracing, an arched crown girder and ball finials to y71; the deck is a Warren truss with roads at y29 and subway tracks at y23. Cable heights come from the given formulas; the anchorage is rusticated granite with a round-arch vault (crown y19) over a cobbled plaza. Brief conflicts I settled: the deck runs through the legs as through a portal, the x6 leg columns sit on girders at y20..21 and y32..33, cables end in a slab (no full top to spawn on), and the stacked Xs make the brief's three panels. Block ids are checked for 1.21.1; nothing has been built or rendered yet. Pale blue-grey riveted steel towers with X-bracing, arched crown and ball finials; Warren double-deck truss with four diorite cables and suspenders; granite anchorage with vaulted archway over cobbled plaza.
Plan.md extended with palette, vocabulary, parts; elements.md checklist written.

parts.name: Tower and deck steelwork
parts.scope: plot 0 pier, legs, X bracing, girders; plot 1 deck; pier, leg_column, xbrace, truss_panel, road_bay

parts.name: Crown
parts.scope: plot 0 y58..71 crown_arch, cornice, finials, saddles

parts.name: Cables
parts.scope: plots 2 and 3 cables and suspenders, tower stubs at y61..62; cable_run, suspender

parts.name: Deck fittings
parts.scope: railings, lamp posts, lane marks, rails in plots 0,1

parts.name: Anchorage
parts.scope: plot 4 granite block, archway, plaza, voussoirs, housings, deck on top

parts.name: Lighting and weathering
parts.scope: lanterns on RESERVED cells, floodlights, light moss
